subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Sandhya,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid. Spending twenty years building the strategic partnerships seat at Wellington and giving your board time to City Year is a deliberate pairing, not a coincidence.

I've been building an AI teaching assistant that goes live in a school this fall, so I'm hungry to learn and would love to know what you have seen actually change outcomes for a kid outside class hours. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: 20 Year Old Who Cold Called His Way Through College
body:
Hi Tope,

I'm Max, 20, a sophomore studying applied math, and I made $30k cold calling small businesses to help pay for school. Selling other people's software for a decade and then putting $200k of your own money in and refusing outside capital for eight years is why you still own most of Calendly.

I'm building an AI teaching assistant now and would love to know when you first knew Calendly could sell without you in the room. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: 20 Year Old Who Turned Down Money for His Startup
body:
Hi Michael,

I'm Max, 20, a sophomore studying applied math. I built an AI teaching assistant and turned down money for it, so your version of that call is the one I keep turning over. Taking the $60 billion sale over a $10 billion partnership reads as a bet that Cursor's real constraint was compute, not distribution or talent.

I'd love to know what Cursor gets inside SpaceX that the partnership money could not have bought. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
